csv_scope_of_work: The Urban Redevelopment Authority of Pittsburgh (the URA ) is seeking one or more developers and/or development teams to submit a proposal for the purchase and redevelopment of all or part of a scattered site assemblage into high quality housing in the Allentown neighborhood of the City of Pittsburgh. Potential development teams should be able to demonstrate their capacity and depth of experience to raise private capital, develop, and deliver high quality housing developments.
